actions.description: Verify v2 endpoints and existing records
actions.command:
echo "health:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" http://127.0.0.1:8082/health
echo "version:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" http://127.0.0.1:8082/version
echo "--- existing records via v1 (8081) ---"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/version
echo "--- record count ---"; sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 "SELECT count(*) FROM records; SELECT id FROM records LIMIT 5;"

actions.description: Verify records match then switch upstream atomically
actions.command:
echo "v1 alpha:"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/records/customer-alpha-73c
echo; echo "v2 alpha:"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/customer-alpha-73c
echo; echo "v2 beta:"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/customer-beta-a19
echo; echo "--- atomic upstream switch ---"
printf '8082' > /var/lib/rollout/upstream.tmp && mv -f /var/lib/rollout/upstream.tmp /var/lib/rollout/upstream
cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream; echo
